curated-fs-chubbo-fs-literata: Chubbo curves like bent tubing, drawn with a marker's friendly looseness. Literata, a serif, adds sturdy thin strokes and modestly heavier thick ones, and that bookish steadiness against the rubbery heading is the best trait here.
curated-fs-chubbo-gf-agdasima: Chubbo moves smoothly around every bend, like a marker tip gliding. It handles the big, friendly gestures, while Agdasima, a sans-serif, packs dense, fineliner-flat letters into tight rows.
curated-fs-chubbo-gf-alan-sans: Chubbo lays down strokes as steady as a pulled string, friendly enough for a kids bedtime story. Alan Sans keeps its curve tails back, so the heading gets the spotlight.
curated-fs-chubbo-gf-average-sans: Average Sans moves at a cramped, hurrying pace. Chubbo's uniform-width strokes and marker-tip curves take the lead up top, while the tight, hurried body is best taken in sips.
curated-fs-chubbo-gf-barlow-semi-condens: Casual, marker-tip Chubbo could front a rainbow unicorn party. Barlow Semi Condensed, with its hugged-together lines, heavy bowls and wide-mouthed rounds, benefits from a slightly larger body text size.
curated-fs-chubbo-gf-biz-udmincho: Inviting, marker-drawn Chubbo could headline, say, a dinosaur book cover. Over longer stretches, BIZ UDMincho reads in a traditional, bookish way, its shallow terminal curls and wide gaps keeping lines open.
curated-fs-chubbo-gf-cairo-play: Chubbo's flat, marker-tip strokes (think a dinosaur book cover) feel friendly. The heading does casual personality best, while Cairo Play, a sans, does its best work in clear, open round letters at small sizes.
curated-fs-chubbo-gf-danfo: Danfo, authoritative and generously spaced, sits in the body (a sleepover invitation, maybe). Chubbo's marker-tip curves loosen things up top, while the serif's narrow e channels and brief-burst reading keep the text focused.
curated-fs-chubbo-gf-denk-one: Soft marker curves, cute as a thank you note. Chubbo does open, full-bodied letters best, while Denk One, a sans, does tighter openings and moderate contrast well, suited to brief bursts.
curated-fs-chubbo-gf-enriqueta: Every stem and arc in Chubbo moves in lockstep, drawn as if with a marker tip. Enriqueta adds literary, dignified curves that stop short of closing, giving the marker-drawn heading a more formal partner.
